1) Comparative Politics
2) THE DECISION-MAKING PROCESS OF THE EUROPEAN UNION: AN INSIDERS VIEW
3) Geopolitics and Heritage Dynamics in the Balkans
4) Israeli Politics through Cinema
5) THE EURO, MIGRATION AND CLIMATE CHANGE: EUROPEAN CHALLENGES AND OPPORTUNITIES

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
